title: gorak native stylesheet
description: Native Style Editor palette only. Existing frame fields use explicit WML properties, never values inherited from this stylesheet. Resolution: built-in → project → application → frame. Validation here checks layer structure, not resolved inheritance or native property semantics.

standalone.description: Complete standalone stylesheet, independent of the built-in baseline.

group_order.description: Exact native group order, including repeated group labels such as entryfield:2.

groups.description: Named native groups. Null removes an inherited group. Literal colons/percent signs are percent-escaped.

$order.description: Exact native property order. Ordinary value edits do not need this.

$before.description: Place a newly introduced native property before the named inherited property.

_type.description: Exact native XML type; null removes an inherited type.

styles.description: Fixed native slots. A delta may override style2 alone. Resolved slots must be contiguous; entries are never implicitly renumbered.

value.description: Native text stays text: empty strings and "0" are meaningful. Null removes an inherited property. Nested objects preserve native structure.
